The '''Free Spacers Fleet''' was a privateer naval force active during the [[Great Galactic War]]. It was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Zale Barrows]] after [[3660 BBY]], and participated in the [[Battle of Dantooine (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Dantooine]] and the [[Defeat of the Imperial Seventh Fleet|defeat]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Seventh Fleet|Seventh Fleet]] on behalf of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The fleet saw its last action at the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].
